overview: File combines a 1930 Dairen despatch on 1928-29 Kwantung life-insurance statistics with a 1933 memo on the Kwantung budget, new borrowing, and opium revenue.

subfiles.title: Despatch from Cabot Coville on life-insurance statistics in the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.from: Cabot Coville, American Vice Consul at Dairen
subfiles.about: The despatch supplies 1928–1929 statistics for post-office and other life insurance in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: Coville reports Kwantung post-office insurance rose from 59,206 to 62,638 policies in 1928-29, while other insurers declined in number but grew modestly.

subfiles.title: Division of Far Eastern Affairs memorandum on the Kwantung Government budget
subfiles.from: U.S. Department of State, Division of Far Eastern Affairs
subfiles.about: The memorandum summarizes a Dairen despatch concerning the Kwantung Government’s proposed budget and its political and fiscal implications.
subfiles.summary: Memo: Kwantung's budget rose to ¥25.8 million, funded partly by a National Treasury grant and new loan for the 'Manchuria situation,' plus opium-monopoly revenue.

interest: Shows 1928-29 Kwantung life-insurance statistics and a 1933 budget memo on Manchuria financing.
